RE: Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC’s Rider Summary Compliance Tariffs
Docket No. E-7, Sub 1285
Dear Ms. Dunston:
Pursuant to the North Carolina Utilities Commission’s Rule R8-25(a), enclosed is
Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC’s Rider Summary Compliance Tariffs that have been revised
to reflect approved changes in rates, incorporating the revised billing factors approved by
the Commission’s Order Approving DSM/EE Rider and Requiring Filing of Proposed
Customer Notice issued August 29, 2023 and effective for a service rendered basis on and
after January 1, 2024. The Rider Summary Compliance Tariffs are provided in both clean
and redlined forms.
Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions or need additional
information.
Sincerely,
Robert W. Kaylor
